title: Static Analysis Guidance for Secure LLM Code Generation
abstract: arXiv:2611.26312v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Static analyzers are cheap and widely deployed, which makes their reports a candidate feedback signal for secure LLM code generation. Existing approaches place the analyzer inside an iterative repair loop with intermediate steps, which is costly and makes it hard to isolate the report's effect on the model. We introduce two strategies that give the finding to the model during generation. When the analyzer raises an alert, generation is rolled back, and the finding is inserted either as a code comment (Comment) or in the user message (Steering). We compare them with two iterative approaches and a control without the analyzer, across three models and three Python benchmarks, and we measure security using each benchmark's oracle. Guidance during generation is cheap and can be effective, at 0.9 to 1.9 times the baseline's output tokens against up to 24.1 times for iterative approaches. translated_title: 静态分析指导的安全LLM代码生成
translated_abstract: 静态分析器成本低廉且被广泛部署，这使得其报告成为安全LLM代码生成的候选反馈信号。现有方法将分析器置于包含中间步骤的迭代修复循环中，这不仅成本高昂，而且难以分离报告本身对模型的影响。我们提出了两种在生成过程中直接将分析发现提供给模型的策略：当分析器发出警报时，回滚生成过程，并将发现结果以代码注释的形式插入，或插入到用户消息中。我们在三个模型和三个Python基准测试上，将这两种策略与两种迭代方法以及不使用分析器的对照组进行比较，并使用每个基准测试的判定标准来衡量安全性。结果表明，生成过程中的指导成本低且可能有效，其输出token仅为基线的0.9至1.9倍，而迭代方法则高达24.1倍。在RiskyPy基准上使用DeepSeek-V4.1-flash时，Steering方法提升了（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出两种在代码生成过程中直接利用静态分析报警信号的新策略（代码注释回滚插入与用户消息引导），相比成本高昂的迭代修复循环，仅需基线0.9至1.9倍的输出token即可有效提升LLM生成代码的安全性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces two strategies that feed static analyzer findings to LLMs during code generation—via generation rollback with inserted code comments or user-message steering—achieving improved code security at only 0.9-1.9x baseline output token cost, far cheaper than iterative repair loops.
